structured.answer: I'd pick Harel's "עוקב מדד S&P 500" track (13414): it's the S&P thing everyone talks about, it shows 13.7% over 3 years and 11.92% over 5, and it holds 2.3 billion, while the fees are about the same as every other track.

findings.what: Most tracks show no return, just 'פחות מ־3 שנים', so I end up picking by the one familiar name
Fees only as small percents, all nearly the same; I can't feel how much it costs
Two fee types (מהחיסכון / מההפקדה) with no plain explanation next to them
No next step or how to sign up on the page
Jargon like מט"ח and חשיפה in the charts
